Async load retains its intent until success; progress/cancel remains reachable while the decision modal is hidden during file work
Save completion and intent cleanup require the originating serial, preserving newer UI decisions
Existing generation pins, save association/dirty checks and load supersession remain; ordinary standalone picker behavior is unchanged
SDK, public IDs/schema, models and project format are unchanged; auditor records the three guarded callback factories
